scheme: PM-AJAY (Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
disclaimer: Indicative prototype values for demonstration. Actual entitlements are notified by MoSJE / State SC Welfare Departments.

benefit_heads.name: Skill Training Support
benefit_heads.description: Full course fee sponsorship for NSQF-aligned training of SC beneficiaries at empanelled centres.
benefit_heads.indicative_amount_inr: Up to 40,000 per candidate (course-linked common norms)

benefit_heads.name: RPL Assessment & Bridge Course Support
benefit_heads.description: Covers RPL assessment fee plus 12-60 hour bridge/orientation module for experienced workers.

benefit_heads.name: Toolkit / Equipment Grant
benefit_heads.description: One-time grant for tools and equipment so a certified beneficiary can start work immediately.
eligibility: Certified in relevant QP or RPL

benefit_heads.name: Enterprise Capital Support (Grant + Subsidised Credit)
benefit_heads.description: Seed grant component blended with NSFDC / bank credit linkage for micro-enterprise setup.
benefit_heads.indicative_amount_inr: Grant up to 1,00,000 + credit linkage up to 5,00,000
eligibility: Certified or RPL-certified in the trade

benefit_heads.name: Stipend / Wage Compensation During Training
benefit_heads.description: Daily stipend to offset lost daily wages while attending full-time training.

benefit_heads.name: Travel & Hostel Support
benefit_heads.description: Conveyance allowance for centres beyond 10 km and hostel charges for residential batches.
benefit_heads.indicative_amount_inr: Rs. 1,500 per month conveyance / Rs. 3,000 per month hostel
eligibility: Training centre beyond 10 km from residence

benefit_heads.name: Placement & Post-Placement Support
benefit_heads.description: Placement facilitation through NCS plus post-placement retention support for 3 months.
